description: Configure the server-wide lockdown system. This is separate from per-channel lock/unlock commands.

content.name: enabled
content.description: Enables the /moderate lockdown command and automatic lockdown triggers

content.name: logChannel
content.description: Channel where detailed lockdown log entries are posted. Falls back to the moderation log channel if not set.

content.name: sendMessageInAffectedChannels
content.description: If enabled, the lockdown/lift message will be sent in every affected channel

content.name: lockdownMessageChannels
content.description: If set, lockdown/lift messages will only be sent in these channels instead of all affected channels. Leave empty to send in all affected channels.

content.name: lockdownMessage
content.description: Message sent in affected channels when lockdown is activated
content.default: 🔒 **Server Lockdown** - This server is currently in lockdown mode. Reason: %reason%

params.name: user
params.description: User who activated the lockdown (or 'System' for automatic)

content.name: liftMessage
content.description: Message sent in affected channels when lockdown is lifted
content.default: 🔓 **Lockdown Lifted** - The server lockdown has been lifted. You can chat again.

content.name: autoLiftAfter
content.description: Automatically lift the lockdown after this many minutes. Set to 0 to require manual lifting.

content.name: autoTriggerOnJoinRaid
content.description: Automatically activate lockdown when the anti-join-raid system is triggered

content.name: autoTriggerOnJoinGate
content.description: Automatically activate lockdown when the join-gate system is triggered. Thresholds are configured in the Join-Gate configuration.

content.name: autoTriggerOnSpam
content.description: Automatically activate lockdown when the anti-spam system is triggered. Thresholds are configured in the Anti-Spam configuration.
